question: Why was APAC's marketing spend so much lower in 2025 than in 2024?

sql_attempts.sql: SELECT m.channel, SUM(CASE WHEN m.month >= '2024-01' AND m.month <= '2024-12' THEN m.amount ELSE 0 END) AS spend_2024, SUM(CASE WHEN m.month >= '2025-01' AND m.month <= '2025-12' THEN m.amount ELSE 0 END) AS spend_2025, SUM(CASE WHEN m.month >= '2025-01' AND m.month <= '2025-12' THEN m.amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN m.month >= '2024-01' AND m.month <= '2024-12' THEN m.amount ELSE 0 END) AS change_amount FROM marketing_spend AS m JOIN regions AS r ON m.region_id = r.region_id WHERE r.region_name = 'APAC' AND m.month >= '2024-01' AND m.month <= '2025-12' GROUP BY m.channel ORDER BY change_amount ASC LIMIT 500

answer: Assuming the overall decrease is evaluated by marketing channel, APAC's spend fell across all channels in 2025, driven mainly by the Direct channel, which decreased by 69,630.40 (from 217,971.33 in 2024 to 148,340.93 in 2025). Spend in the Partner channel also dropped by 36,992.74 (from 199,937.33 to 162,944.59), while the Online channel saw a minor reduction of 3,268.14 (from 199,580.97 to 196,312.83).
